biomarkers.name: HER2 (ERBB2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Trastuzumab + chemo first-line (ToGA); pembrolizumab + trastuzumab + chemo (KEYNOTE-811); T-DXd in later lines (DESTINY-Gastric)

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS by 22C3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Nivolumab + chemo (CheckMate 649  benefit CPS 55); pembrolizumab combos

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.prevalence: ~8-10% in advanced/metastatic disease; ~10-20% overall resected series
biomarkers.clinical_use: Dramatic response to immune checkpoint inhibitors; consider IO-only first-line in selected advanced MSI-H disease; germline testing when Lynch syndrome is suspected

biomarkers.name: EBV
biomarkers.clinical_use: Better prognosis; frequent PD-L1/PD-L2 amplification; IO responsive

biomarkers.name: CLDN18.2 (Claudin 18.2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Zolbetuximab + chemo (SPOTLIGHT, GLOW)  first-line CLDN18.2+ HER2- advanced

biomarkers.name: FGFR2b / FGFR2 amplification
biomarkers.prevalence: FGFR2 amplification ~3-7%; FGFR2b protein overexpression higher

biomarkers.name: MET amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: MET inhibitor trials; less established than in lung

biomarkers.name: TCGA molecular subtypes: EBV, MSI, GS (genomically stable  usually diffuse/signet-ring), CIN (chromosomal instability)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Emerging framework; guides IO and targeted therapy considerations

biomarkers.name: CDH1 germline (hereditary diffuse gastric cancer)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Prophylactic gastrectomy for germline carriers; associated with lobular breast cancer risk

biomarkers.name: CA 19-9, CEA
biomarkers.clinical_use: Monitoring in metastatic disease when elevated at baseline

biomarkers.name: NTRK1/2/3 fusion
biomarkers.type: fusion testing (NGS or IHC + confirmatory molecular assay)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Tissue-agnostic TRK inhibitor therapy when present

biomarkers.name: RET fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Potential eligibility for selective RET inhibitor therapy in rare fusion-positive cases

biomarkers.name: KRAS G12C
biomarkers.clinical_use: Potential eligibility for KRAS G12C inhibitor therapy/trials in selected cases

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Two dominant Lauren patterns: intestinal-type (glandular, cohesive) and diffuse-type (poorly cohesive with signet-ring morphology, linitis plastica when extensive)
variants: WHO subtypes: papillary, tubular, mucinous, poorly cohesive (including signet-ring)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Well / moderately / poorly differentiated (WHO); Lauren classification also used

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Varies dramatically by TCGA subtype: EBV+ (hot, high PD-L1), MSI-H (hot, high TMB), GS (cold, diffuse-type), CIN (variable)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse-type has extensive desmoplastic reaction (linitis plastica); intestinal-type more glandular

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Gastric mucosal epithelial cells (foveolar, mucous neck, or chief cells); diffuse-type may originate from isthmus stem cells
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm  foregut derivative (stomach from primitive foregut)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intestinal-type (Lauren)  gland-forming, resembles colonic adenocarcinoma; Diffuse-type (Lauren)  signet ring cells with E-cadherin loss and discohesive growth
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: H. pylori-driven chronic gastritis  atrophy  intestinal metaplasia  dysplasia  intestinal-type adenocarcinoma (Correa cascade); diffuse-type from stem cells with CDH1 loss (independent pathway)
